httpPort.description: 0 means no monitoring, -1 means some available port

nodeSelector.description:
Node labels for pod assignment
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/user-guide/node-selection/

tolerations.description:
Node tolerations for server scheduling to nodes with taints
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/assign-pod-node/
- key: "key"
operator: "Equal|Exists"
value: "value"
effect: "NoSchedule|PreferNoSchedule|NoExecute(1.6 only)"

anyOf.description: Name must be unique within a namespace. Is required when creating resources, although some resources may allow a client to request the generation of an appropriate name automatically. Name is primarily intended for creation idempotence and configuration definition. Cannot be updated. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names#names
